title: RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion
title_zh: RECAP：面向高效视频扩散的互惠稀疏注意力与分层缓存

paragraphs.en: 总结：RECAP提出无需训练的稀疏注意力与分层缓存协同校正方法，在视频扩散模型上实现3.05倍加速并提升生成保真度。 Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：RECAP提出无需训练的稀疏注意力与分层缓存协同校正方法，在视频扩散模型上实现3.05倍加速并提升生成保真度。扩散变换器能够生成高质量视频，但计算成本依然高昂。 稀疏注意力与时间缓存分别减少去噪步内与去噪步间的计算，二者构成一种天然的组合。 然而，使用稀疏注意力得到的预测会成为时间复用的来源，使其误差沿采样轨迹相互耦合。 我们观察到，提高这些来源的精度可以在不改变复用调度的情况下恢复保真度，并且稀疏化误差在相邻步之间保持方向上的一致，这表明校正信息可以被共享而非重复计算。 这些观察催生了RECAP，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过相互校正将稀疏注意力与分层缓存结合起来，并由在线误差反馈自适应协调。 缓存的密集细化校正当前稀疏估计中被遗漏的交互，而新鲜的稀疏统计则跟踪输入变化并调节老化的校正。 由此得到的预测随后更新整步预测复用的来源，使预测历史能够在两次密集刷新之间不断推进。 我们在多个视频扩散模型上，将RECAP与稀疏注意力方法、缓存方法及其直接组合进行对比评估。 在HunyuanVideo的720p 5秒生成任务上，RECAP实现了3.05倍加速，并在保真度和推理速度上均优于所有测试过的直接组合方法。
